exposure: prescription opioid supply >=90 days during pregnancy
prescription opioid supply >=180 days during pregnancy
outcome: prevalence of chronic opioid use during pregnancy
types of opioids prescribed for chronic use
variation in prevalence by geographic region
cohort: The study included 975,169 Medicaid-insured and 1,037,599 commercially insured women identified from the Medicaid Analytic eXtract (2008-2014) and the IBM Health MarketScan Research Database (2008-2015).
finding: The prevalence of chronic opioid use during pregnancy approximately doubled in publicly insured women from 2008-2014, reaching 1.50% (>=90 days' supply) and 0.78% (>=180 days' supply), while remaining relatively stable and 5-fold less common in commercially insured women.
